# GeeksforGeeks

> > GeeksforGeeks is a comprehensive learning platform offering tutorials, courses, and practice problems for computer science fundamentals, programming languages, data structures, algorithms, and emerging technologies.

GeeksforGeeks serves as an all-in-one educational portal for students and professionals learning DSA, programming languages (Python, Java, C++, JavaScript), machine learning, data science, and DevOps. The platform combines free tutorials with structured self-paced and live courses, interview preparation resources, and hands-on coding practice.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
- Python Programming
- Java Programming
- C++ Programming
- JavaScript & Web Development
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- System Design
- DevOps & Linux
- Interview Preparation
- Object-Oriented Programming
- Deep Learning
- Competitive Programming
- Web Development Technologies
- Artificial Intelligence

## Core Learning Hub

- [GeeksforGeeks Homepage](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org): Main learning portal for DSA, programming languages, and interview prep
- [DSA Tutorial - Learn Data Structures and Algorithms](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/dsa-tutorial-learn-data-structures-and-algorithms): Comprehensive DSA tutorial covering data structures, algorithms, and interview preparation fundamentals
- [Practice Platform](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/explore): Interactive practice platform for coding problems, challenges, and interview question solving
- [Courses Portal](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses): Online courses including DSA, system design, data science, and backend development

## Programming Languages

- [Python Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/python-programming-language-tutorial): Python programming guide with Django, Flask, NumPy, and web development basics
- [Java Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/java/java): Java tutorial covering JVM concepts, OOP, and fundamentals for beginners
- [C++ Programming Language](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/cpp/c-plus-plus): C++ tutorial covering OOP, competitive programming, and language fundamentals
- [C Programming Language](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/c/c-programming-language): C programming tutorial covering language basics, syntax, and fundamental concepts
- [JavaScript Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript/javascript-tutorial): JavaScript guide covering web development, React, and client-side programming

## Data Science & Machine Learning

- [Machine Learning Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning/machine-learning): ML tutorial covering supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning with Python
- [Data Science Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/data-science/data-science-for-beginners): Data science tutorial with Python, NumPy, machine learning, and data analysis fundamentals
- [AI, ML and Data Science Guide](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/ai-ml-ds): Comprehensive AI, ML, data science guide with Python, deep learning, NLP, and computer vision
- [Data Science Project Based Learning Course](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses/data-science-live): Project-based data science course with Python, SQL, Pandas, and ML fundamentals

## Advanced Topics & System Design

- [System Design: Low-Level to High-Level Course](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses/mastering-system-design-low-level-to-high-level-solutions): System design course covering OOP, design patterns, scalable architecture, and interview prep
- [Data Structures and Algorithms - Self Paced Course](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses/dsa-self-paced): Self-paced DSA course covering arrays, trees, graphs, sorting, and interview preparation
- [Web Development Technologies](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/web-development): Web development overview covering frontend, backend, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript basics

## Infrastructure & DevOps

- [DevOps Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/devops/devops-tutorial): DevOps tutorial with Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD fundamentals
- [Linux Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/linux-unix/linux-tutorial): Linux tutorial covering OS basics, commands, DevOps, and system administration
